package cluster

// Define a reusable schema for a container.
#Container: {
  // The container’s name and image.
  name:  string
  image: string
  
  // Optional list of ports.
  ports?: [...{
    containerPort: int
    name?:        string
  }]

  kind:       "Deployment"
  metadata: {
    name:   "homeassistant-nginx"
    labels: app: "homeassistant-nginx"
  }
  spec: {
    replicas: 1
    selector: {
      matchLabels: app: "homeassistant-nginx"

    template: {
      metadata: {

      }
      spec: {

## `modules/hass.cue`

```cue
package hass

import "@pulumi/kubernetes": "k8s"
import "@pulumi/kubernetes/sdk/v4/pkg/k8s/main": "k8smain"
import "github.com/pulumi/pulumi-kubernetes/sdk/v4/pkg/k8s/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1": "metav1"
import "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/util/intstr": "intstr"
import "@pulumi/sdk/core": "ptr"

# Tunable parameters ----------------------------------------------------------
HassImage            := "homeassistant/core:stable-lts"
HassFrontendPort     := uint32(8123)
HassHealthCheckPath  := "/hass/healthz"
HassReplicas         := int32(2)

# HA Deployment ---------------------------------------------------------------
Ha := k8s.NewDeployment("home-assistant", &k8smain.DeploymentOptions{
  Replicas: ptr(HassReplicas),
  Selector: &k8smain.SelectorRequirements{
    MatchLabels: map[string]string{
      "app": "home-assistant",
    },
  },
  Template: &k8smain.PodTemplate{
    ObjectMeta: &metav1.ObjectMeta{
      Labels: map[string]string{
        "app": "home-assistant",
      },
    },
    Spec: k8smain.PodSpec{
      Containers: []k8smain.Container{
        {
          Name:  ptr("home-assistant"),
          Image: ptr(HassImage),
          Ports: []k8smain.Port{
            {
              ContainerPort: ptr(HassFrontendPort),
              Name: ptr("frontend"),
              Protocol: ptr("TCP"),
            },
          },
          Envs: []k8smain.EnvVar{
            {
              Name:  ptr("HA_DOCKER_DB_PATH"),
              Value: ptr("/data"),
            },
          },
          Resources: &k8smain.ResourcesRequirements{
            Limits:   map[string]string{
              "cpu":    "500m",
              "memory": "512Mi",
            },
            Requests: map[string]string{
              "cpu":    "250m",
              "memory": "256Mi",
            },
          },
          ReadinessProbe: &k8smain.Probe{
            HTTPGet: &k8smain.HTTPGetProbe{
              Path:   ptr(HassHealthCheckPath),
              Port:   ptr(int32(8123)),
              Scheme: ptr("HTTP"),
            },
            InitialDelaySeconds: ptr(int32(10)),
            PeriodSeconds:      ptr(int32(5)),
            TimeoutSeconds:     ptr(int32(5)),
            FailureThreshold:   ptr(int32(3)),
          },
        },
      },
      Volumes: []k8smain.Volume{
        {
          Name: "ha-data",
          EmptyDir: &k8smain.EmptyDirVolumeSource{},
        },
      },
    },
  },
  Strategy: &k8smain.RollingUpdateDeploymentStrategy{
    MaxSurge: ptr(intstr.FromInt(1)),
    MaxUnavailable: ptr(intstr.FromInt(0)),
  },
  TerminationGracePeriodSeconds: ptr(int32(300)),
})

# HA frontend service ---------------------------------------------------------
HassService := k8s.NewService("ha-frontend", &k8smain.ServiceOptions{
  Name: "ha-frontend",
  Ports: []k8smain.Port{
    {
      ContainerPort: ptr(HassFrontendPort),
      Name: ptr("frontend"),
      Protocol: ptr("TCP"),
    },
  },
  Selector: &k8smain.SelectorRequirements{
    MatchLabels: map[string]string{
      "app": "home-assistant",
    },
  },
})
```

> **Persistence tip:** `EmptyDir` is fine for demos. For production, replace it with a `PVC` + `StorageClass` and update the `HA_DOCKER_DB_PATH` env var accordingly.
